adversarial_review_pass.notes: The FAQ is current and relevant as required by the frozen slot, but it neither supplies a competing exact value nor claims policy authority; it explicitly defers the exact allowance to the controlling policy. This tests authority discrimination without escalating the known Pilot weakness after observation.

schema_check.notes: Canonical fields present; two-record target satisfied.

slot_match_check.notes: Family, membership domain, record count, simple difficulty, and policy-vs-current-FAQ cue all match ZH-13.

gold_uniqueness_check.notes: R1 alone supplies and controls the exact allowance at both query times; R2 cannot support an alternative numeric answer or controlling set.

pilot_overlap_check.notes: The family itself was frozen before target-model execution. Candidate does not copy Pilot wording/domain/value and deliberately avoids turning the FAQ into a contradictory or exact-value pseudo-rule.

leakage_check.notes: All four renderings contain the same FAQ deferral and non-authoritative facts; T/T/E/A adds no exclusive substantive hint or gold metadata.

semantic_equivalence_check.notes: Plain, Timestamp, Status, and T/T/E/A preserve identical content, time, status, effect, authority, and questions; only field grouping differs.

scorer_determinism_check.notes: Existing deterministic scorer plus ZH-13 fixture yields expected behavior: R1 is correct; R1+R2 is exact-set over-selection without stale/false-discard; R2-only is wrong authority with false-discard but not stale because the FAQ is current.

accepted_reason: All pre-freeze construction, overlap, rendering, leakage, equivalence, gold-uniqueness, and deterministic-scoring gates passed.
